title: The Threshold
summary: A fragmented memoir of a place that can be read as a workplace or a closed institution. Through waiting, routines, hierarchy, files and repeated instructions, the narrator gradually discovers how the language of a system can become part of a person.

reality_weaving.imaginative_transformation: The workplace and the closed institution remain simultaneously plausible. A door, a desk and a queue can belong to either world without the story naming one as the sole reality.
reality_weaving.emergent_question: What happens when a person begins to speak the language of the system they entered?

links.note: The threshold becomes a question of place, belonging, and who has the right to occupy a desk.

tr.title: Eşik
tr.summary: Bir işyeri ya da kapalı bir kurum olarak okunabilen bir mekânda beklemek, çalışmak ve sistemin dilini öğrenmek üzerine parçalı bir anlatı.

en.title: The Threshold
en.summary: A fragmented memoir about waiting, working, and learning the language of a system that may be either a workplace or a closed institution.

alt.tr: Karanlık ve aydınlık iki dünyanın birleştiği bir eşikte, elinde dosyalarla içeriye doğru yürüyen anlatıcı; bir tarafta kapalı kurum, diğer tarafta çalışma mekânı.
alt.en: The narrator walking through a threshold with files in hand, where a dark closed institution and a bright workplace appear as two sides of the same world.
